summary: 54-year-old Florida man drove a small SUV off Trail Ridge Road east of Gore Range Overlook ~8:50 p.m. Thursday; vehicle came to rest ~500 ft down the steep slope. NPS Search and Rescue and Estes Valley Fire assisted the man up to the road; he was transported out of the park by Estes Park Health ambulance. Trail Ridge Road closed ~2 hrs during the rescue and ~4 hrs the next morning for vehicle extraction.
location: Trail Ridge Road east of Gore Range Overlook, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue; Estes Valley Fire Protection District; Estes Park Health
notes: Parent-opened NPS news release (Sept 2, 2022). NPS's own wording: 'While the occupant was being rescued'; release thanks 'the park's Search and Rescue team'. Injuries unstated; outcome=assist per the id-2976 (Alpine 2026-132 vehicle-over-edge) precedent. Run 821 RMNP chunk.
